title: Size bound for the De Morgan transformation
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose every gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. If the size of a circuit is its number of input vertices plus its number of gates, then the transformed circuit has size at most $n + |G|(s+2)$, where $|G|$ is the number of gates of $C$ and $s=n+|G|$ is its size.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
